name: Claude Code + rtk
description: Installs the Claude Code CLI and the rtk token-optimizing output proxy into /usr/local/bin, with optional rtk<->Claude Code wiring for the remote user. Uses the native installer, so no Node.js is required.

claudeVersion.description: Claude Code version to install ('stable', 'latest', or a pinned version such as 2.1.238).

rtkInitClaude.description: Run 'rtk init -g' for the remote user to wire rtk into Claude Code. Ignored in practice when you bind-mount a host ~/.claude over the remote user's home.
